8. **iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF USD Acc (IE00B4L5Y983): 0.20%** [IE00B4L5Y983 factsheet p.1]

- The Invesco factsheet is dated 30 September 2026. I did not confirm the as-of dates for the other factsheets.
